Supply paperboy with existing crawl data

Source: R/supply.R
pb_supply.Rd

This function lets you use pb_deliver to parse already-collected raw HTML by constructing a suitable data.frame. It is broadly equivalent to pb_collect, but collects no data.

Usage

pb_supply(
  data,
  url = "url",
  content_raw = NULL,
  content_filenames = NULL,
  expanded_url = NULL,
  domain = NULL,
  status = NULL,
  collected_at = lubridate::now()
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame with input data. At a minimum this must contain a column of original urls and one of raw HTML data fetched from these URLs.

url

The column name containing the original URLs.

content_raw

A column name containing the raw HTML fetched from these URLs. Exactly one of content_raw and content_filenames must be provided.

content_filenames

A column name containing filenames for the raw HTML data fetched from these URLs. Exactly one of content_raw and content_filenames must be provided.

expanded_url

The column name containing final (normalized and/or redirected) URLs. If NULL, curl_parse_url is used to normalize the URLs in data[[urls]].

domain

The column name containing the domain to be used to select a parser by pb_deliver. If NULL, the correct domains are calculated.

status

The column name containing HTTP response codes. If NULL, 200 ("OK") is assumed for for all pages.

collected_at

The POSIXct time when the data were collected. Note that paperboy records a single time per data.frame, not per URL.

Value

A data.frame (tibble) equivalent to that returned from pb_collect.

Details

If content_raw is provided, content will be kept in memory, as with pb_collect(save_dir = NULL). If content_filenames is provided then the output data.frame will contain links to the data files, as with pb_collect(save_dir = 'some_directory').

Examples

df <- dplyr::tibble(
  url = c('bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz7dlgejqylo',
          'bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1l1r1zne1ro'),
  html_data = c('<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en-GB" class="no-js"><he...',
                '<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en-GB"><head><meta name=...'),
  expanded_url = c('https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz7dlgejqylo',
                   'https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1l1r1zne1ro')
)
pb_supply(df,
          content_raw = 'html_data',
          expanded_url = 'expanded_url',
          collected_at = lubridate::ymd_hms('2026-08-20 11:14:05')
)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 5
#>   url                                  expanded_url    domain status content_raw
#>   <chr>                                <chr>           <chr>   <int> <html_cnt> 
#> 1 bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz7dlgejqylo https://www.bb… bbc.c…    200 <!DOCTYPE …
#> 2 bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1l1r1zne1ro https://www.bb… bbc.c…    200 <!DOCTYPE …
